senses.gloss:
वियत् 1. वि-यत्, cl. 1. A. -यतते, -यतितुम्,
to dispose in various rows (?): Caus. -यातयति, -यि-
तुम्, to place in rows, arrange, dispose of; to do
penance; to pain, torment, harass, disturb; to punish.

वियत् 2. वि-यत्, त्, n. (probably connected
with वि-यम् below; but according to some, pres.
part. of rt. 5. इ with 2. वि; according to others fr.
rt. 1. वी), sky, heaven, ether, atmosphere.
—वियच्-
चारिन्, ई, m. ‘sky-goer,’ a kite (= चिल्ल).
—वियद्-
गङ्गा, f. ‘sky-Ganges,’ the heavenly Ganges; the
galaxy.
—वियद्-गति, इस्, f. going or moving in the
air.
—वियद्-भूति, इस्, f. ‘sky-power,’ darkness.
—वियन्-मणि, इस्, m. ‘sky-gem,’ the sun.

वि-यति, इस्, m. (perhaps connected with the above),
a bird; N. of a son of Nahuṣa.

वियम् वि-यम्, cl. 1. P. -यच्छति, -यन्तुम्,
to stretch out, extend, spread out; to present, grant,
bestow, give; to stretch apart; to restrain: Caus.
-यामयति, -यितुम्, to cause to stretch out, extend,
expand.

वि-यत, अस्, आ, अम्, stretched out, extended, kept
apart; (अम्), ind. separately, at intervals, intermit-
tingly.

वि-यात, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘gone apart or from the right
path,’ abandoned; shameless, impudent, ill-behaved.

वि-यम, अस्, m. restraint, check; rest, cessation,
stop; pain, distress.
वि-याम, अस्, m. restraint, &c. (= वि-यम).

विया वि-या, cl. 2. P. -याति, -यातुम्, to go
away, depart, leave; to go through, pervade, pass
through, go across, to run through, drive through;
to pierce, destroy.

वियु वि-यु (see rt. 1. यु), cl. 3. P. -यु-
योति, &c., to be separated or parted, to separate (in-
trans.), be dissolved; to be separated from or deprived
of (with inst.); to separate, exclude, deprive of (with
inst.); to keep off, ward off.

वि-युत, अस्, आ, अम् (see 1. and 2. युत, p. 817),
separated, deprived of, separated from (with inst.,
e. g. वत्सैर् वियुताः, [cows] separated from their
calves).
—वियुतार्थक (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, void
of meaning.

वि-योतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. separating; warding
off, defending; (Sāy.) one who does not mix, not
mixing (= दुःखानाम् अमिश्रयितृ, Ṛg-veda IV.
55, 2).
वियोतृ वि-योतृ. See under वि-यु, col. 1.

वियुज् वि-युज्, cl. 7. P. A. -युनक्ति, -युङ्क्ते,
-योक्तुम्, to disjoin, detach, separate, divide; to free
or liberate from, separate from (with inst., rarely
with abl.); to relax, be slackened, give way, yield
(A.): Pass. -युज्यते, to be separated from, be de-
prived of (with inst.); to be relaxed, yield, give way:
Caus. -योजयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to be disjoined,
separate; to free or deliver from, deprive of (with
inst. or abl.).

वि-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, disjoined, detached, sepa-
rated, sundered, severed; separated from, free from,
deprived of, deserted by (with inst. or at the end of
a comp.); failing, deficient.

वि-युज्य, ind. having separated or detached, hav-
ing freed or delivered from.

वि-योग, अस्, m. separation, disunion, disjunction;
loss, death, absence (especially of lovers).
—वियोग-
भाज्, क्, क्, क्, suffering separation.
—वियोग-वाह्य,
अस्, आ, अम्, excluded from separation, not separated.
—वियोगावसान (˚ग-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, ending or
[]
terminating in separation.
—वियोगावसान-त्व, अम्,
n. termination in separation.

वियोगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, being separated or disjoined;
apart, absent, remote; (ई), m. the ruddy goose; (इनी), f.
a woman separated from her husband or lover; a kind
of metre having two unequal half lines, the first con-
taining ten and the second eleven syllables, as follow,
˘˘¯˘˘¯˘¯˘¯, ˘˘¯¯˘˘¯˘¯˘¯, (the fourth
Canto of the Kumāra-sambhava is chiefly written in
this metre.)

वि-योजयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, separating, separating
from; depriving of; lavishing, expending.

वि-योजित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), separated,
disjoined, disunited; separated from, parted from,
deprived of.

वियोनि वि-योनि, इस्, or वि-योनी, f. various
or manifold birth, (according to Kullūka on Manu
XII. 27. ‘the womb of animals’); an ignominious
birth.
—वियोनि-जन्माध्याय (˚म-अध्˚), अस्, m.,
N. of a chapter of Varāha-mihira's Vṛhaj-jātaka.
